p: bone and thy flesh: We are of your kindred and closely related to you.
before the LORD: That is, taking the Lord to witness: for the ark was still in Abinadab's house.
blind and the lame: The children of God called idols blind and lame guides: therefore the Jebusites meant that they should prove that their gods were neither blind nor lame.
come into the house: The idols should no longer enter into that place.
Millo and inward: He built from the town house round about to his own house 1Ch 11:8.
enquired of the LORD: By Abiathar the priest.
Rephaim: Meaning the valley of giants, which David called Baalperazim, because of his victory.
Gazer: Which was in the tribe of Benjamin, but the Philistines possessed it.
